d:
Jethalal gets caught in a bizarre mix-up at Gada Electronics when a customer Daya sent asks for just 200 ml of black paint for a cycle. To offload his wholesale paint inventory, Jethalal ropes in Taarak Mehta to convince the society to repaint the building, assuring everyone he will cover any budget shortfall himself.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
